column1: # The {10,14,20} sweep showed ntil-45 plateaus from randtour 10->20 (t10~=t20
# on solves; t20 has a modest flip-efficiency edge; the t14 dip was noise).
# ntil-43 still improved monotonically to t20, so the uniform-draw tournament
# may not have saturated there yet -- push the randtour axis higher to {20,30,
# 40} and see where it finally turns over.
# 4th config is the weighted-proportional sampler (--wsample=1): draw each
# random-source candidate with probability proportional to its ddfw weight
# instead of uniformly, then take the top-K as usual. Held at randtour=20 so
# it is a matched-budget A/B against the t20 row -- same number of candidates
# sampled per transfer, the only difference is the draw distribution (weighted
# vs uniform). Isolates "does a weighted draw beat a uniform draw + tournament
# at equal cost?". randk stays at its default (1).
